title: Lifeadmin Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeadmin:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often lifeadmin metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on lifeadmin metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how often your lifeadmin metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
